cipher.name: KeyboardRowVerticalShiftCipher
cipher.idea: Shift each letter to the character directly below it on a standard QWERTY keyboard layout. The rows are: Row 1 (qwertypoiu), Row 2 (asdfghjkl), Row 3 (zxcvbnm). If a letter is in Row 1, it shifts to the same column in Row 2. If in Row 2, it shifts to Row 3. If in Row 3, it wraps around to Row 1. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
Map each letter to its vertical neighbor below it on a QWERTY keyboard, wrapping from the bottom row back to the top row. Specifically, use these exact 1-to-1 mappings (preserving case):
- Row 1 to Row 2: q->a, w->s, e->d, r->f, t->g, y->h, u->j, i->k, o->l, p->z
- Row 2 to Row 3: a->x, s->c, d->v, f->b, g->n, h->m, j->q, k->w, l->e
- Row 3 to Row 1: z->r, x->t, c->y, v->u, b->i, n->o, m->p
Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
Reverse the vertical shift mapping:
- Row 2 to Row 1: a->q, s->w, d->e, f->r, g->t, h->y, j->u, k->i, l->o, z->p
- Row 3 to Row 2: x->a, c->s, v->d, b->f, n->g, m->h, q->j, w->k, e->l
- Row 1 to Row 3: r->z, t->x, y->c, u->v, i->b, o->n, p->m
Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.

example.plaintext: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
example.ciphertext: Ghd qjkbk bfoio rlc qjmst lvdg ghd exsc vln.
